summary: Stream pages filter in the messages shard's query and are full unless the stream is exhausted

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or triggers change; the queries use the shard's existing recipient, sender and order indexes.

rules.detail: Which messages a page lists is unchanged: a stream item's recipient, sender and closed state are matched in the shard's query as its view decided them.

compatibility.detail: Page items, order and cursors are unchanged. A page with more to come is now always full, never empty with a next cursor. Nothing writes stream items yet (db break-up step 4a), so members see no difference today.
